outcome: Use of glucose-lowering medicines after delivery
cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who received prenatal checkups and gave birth at two teaching hospitals in southern Taiwan between 1995 and 2011
finding: Prepregnancy BMI and GWG significantly impacted perinatal outcomes for both women with GDM and their newborns.
mod_finding: Women with GDM and an overweight prepregnancy BMI were more likely to have cesarean deliveries.
